The existing `pom.xml` has two issues: the `<exec.mainClass>` property points to `com.example.QpidAmqpApp`, but the actual main class is `com.example.ProtocolApplication`; and the exec plugin configuration uses the `exec:java` goal shape (with `<arguments>`) which cannot apply JVM flags like `-Djava.security.manager=allow`. The correct approach for applying JVM flags is to use the `exec:exec` goal with `<executable>java</executable>` and pass flags as arguments, while keeping `${exec.mainClass}` as the final argument so it respects command-line overrides.

<<<KRIYA:EDIT path="pom.xml">>>
<<<KRIYA:SEARCH>>>
<exec.mainClass>com.example.QpidAmqpApp</exec.mainClass>
<<<KRIYA:REPLACE>>>
<exec.mainClass>com.example.ProtocolApplication</exec.mainClass>
<<<KRIYA:END_EDIT>>>

<<<KRIYA:EDIT path="pom.xml">>>
<<<KRIYA:SEARCH>>>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                <artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.1.0</version>
                <configuration>
                    <executable>java</executable>
                    <arguments>
                        <!-- Required for Qpid broker embedding on JDK 17.0.10+ -->
                        <argument>-Djava.security.manager=allow</argument>
                        <argument>-classpath</argument>
                        <classpath/>
                        <argument>${exec.mainClass}</argument>
                    </arguments>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
<<<KRIYA:REPLACE>>>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                <artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.1.0</version>
                <configuration>
                    <executable>java</executable>
                    <arguments>
                        <!-- Required for Qpid broker embedding on JDK 17.0.10+ -->
                        <argument>-Djava.security.manager=allow</argument>
                        <argument>-classpath</argument>
                        <classpath/>
                        <argument>${exec.mainClass}</argument>
                    </arguments>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
<<<KRIYA:END_EDIT>>>

<<<KRIYA:NO_CHANGE path="pom.xml">>>
